propositions: Plan-review health (pin drift, enforcement posture, phase compatibility) must be surfaced in detailed CLI show, MCP ticket detail, audit output, close errors, and web ticket-review UI without adding noise to ordinary list output or persisting warning events.

All detailed renderers must consume the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract and display canonical related tickets, normalized roles, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and phase metadata using consistent semantics.
Pin enforcement-disabled drift must be labeled advisory and visually distinguishable from legacy-unpinned state, while ordinary list output and persisted ticket events remain unchanged.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at the build_context/page assembly boundary after audit_trail produces stored data, with errors caught and rendered as clearly labeled derived-health unavailable without changing allow/deny semantics.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles; basic user docs must not include this detail.
Existing schemas must be preserved additively for rollback compatibility, and detailed-show golden tests must differentiate intentional plan_review_health addition from unchanged lean list output.
